propositions: When JIRA_PAT environment variable is missing, the client construction falls back to anonymous access instead of raising a named error as documented
An empty or whitespace-only JIRA_PAT value is accepted and treated as valid, allowing anonymous requests to proceed without detection
The failure mode silently produces misleading error messages (like 'project does not exist') that misattribute the root cause to wrong project keys or permissions rather than missing credentials
Settings resolution currently cannot validate the PAT without breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via property evaluation in hasattr
The documented security guarantee that 'missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable' is not enforced anywhere in the codebase
